summary: IAM Recommender generates policy insights and role recommendations for identities in workload identity pools, workforce identity pools, and Google Kubernetes Engine Pods that use a specific Kubernetes service account.
extended_definition: IAM Recommender generates policy insights and role recommendations for identities in workload identity pools, workforce identity pools, and Google Kubernetes Engine Pods that use a specific Kubernetes service account.

supporting_pages.title: "Overview of organization policy recommendations \_|\_ Policy Intelligence\
evidence_snippets: If there are no created service account keys, Organization Policy recommender generates a recommendation to enforce the iam.managed.disableServiceAccountKeyCreation constraint and supporting details of the recommendation in the corresponding insights.

If there are no uploaded service account keys, Organization Policy recommender generates a recommendation to enforce the iam.managed.disableServiceAccountKeyUpload constraint and supporting details of the recommendation in the corresponding insights.

If there are no external protocol forwarding rules defined, Organization Policy recommender generates a recommendation to enforce the compute.managed.restrictProtocolForwardingCreationForTypes constraint and supporting details of the recommendation in the corresponding insights.
